body:
<!-- pr-reviewer: b0ad73ec27cdc958cfbf894e6b70237ada970723 -->
**Ready for the maintainer to merge**

Thanks @mkinney, a clean first slice.

**What looks good**
- Layering is right: the catalogue, validation and sheet live in `camcraft_app::machine::{library,validate,sheet}`. `machines_pane.rs` only draws what they return and reads no file itself.
- Everything Is a Command: the pane is read-only. Selection and the cached list are ephemeral view state, like the dock, so there is nothing to put on the undo history. The PR says that "Use for this setup" will be a command in a follow-up.
- Validation refuses by name (`key: rule`) from the raw JSON, so a backwards travel is no longer silently dropped. I found no `unwrap`, `expect` or `panic!` in the new app or UI code, and a malformed-file test is included.
- `Panel::Machines` is opened from the View door as a tab beside Properties. It does not conflict with #441/#442 (Stock page, Theme button) or the per-setup Machine/Post nodes (#343/#390); it is a separate pane and does not touch those.
- New files are under about 400 lines (`validate.rs` is 341). Provenance lines are present, `docs/decisions/287-machines-pane.md` exists, and the body has `Changelog:` and `Refs #287`.

**Local results** (trial-merged with current main, clean merge, no conflicts; no build.rs, scripts, `.github` or dependency changes)
| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| `camcraft-app --test machine_library` | 11 passed |
| `camcraft-app --test machine` | 32 passed |
| `camcraft-ui --lib machines_pane` / `layout` | 7 passed, 0 failed |
| `clippy -p camcraft-app -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -D warnings` | clean |

**Requested before merge**
None.

**Notes (not blocking)**
- As mkinney's macOS check noted, the Axes group lists axes as Z, Y, X. X, Y, Z would read better (`crates/app/src/machine/sheet.rs`).
- The PR changes `assets/machines/AGENTS.md`, so run `/graphify . --update` after merge.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
